sql: SELECT stage, ROUND(AVG(attendance)) FROM matches GROUP BY stage ORDER BY stage
SELECT referee_country, COUNT(*) AS match_count FROM matches GROUP BY referee_country ORDER BY match_count DESC, referee_country
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(went_to_penalties = 1) / COUNT(*), 1) FROM matches WHERE stage = 'Round of 32'

SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS total_goals FROM goals g JOIN matches m ON g.match_id = m.match_id JOIN teams t ON t.team_id = g.scoring_team_id WHERE m.went_to_penalties = 1 GROUP BY t.team_id, t.team_name ORDER BY total_goals DESC, t.team_name
SELECT match_id, home_ft + away_ft AS total_goals, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY home_ft + away_ft DESC) AS rnk FROM matches ORDER BY rnk, match_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM teams WHERE group_letter = 'J'
SELECT kickoff_time FROM matches WHERE match_id = 82
SELECT player_name FROM cards WHERE match_id = 81 ORDER BY player_name
SELECT s.country, SUM(m.attendance) AS total_attendance FROM matches m JOIN stadiums s ON s.stadium_id = m.stadium_id GROUP BY s.country ORDER BY total_attendance DESC, s.country
SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(c.card_id) FROM teams t LEFT JOIN cards c ON c.team_id = t.team_id AND c.card_type = 'Y' WHERE t.group_letter = 'J' GROUP BY t.team_id, t.team_name ORDER BY t.team_name
SELECT player_name, COUNT(*) FROM goals WHERE match_id = 81 GROUP BY player_name ORDER BY player_name
SELECT s.country, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(m.went_to_extra_time = 1) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct FROM matches m JOIN stadiums s ON s.stadium_id = m.stadium_id GROUP BY s.country ORDER BY pct DESC, s.country
SELECT t.team_name, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(g.is_penalty = 1) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct FROM goals g JOIN teams t ON t.team_id = g.scoring_team_id GROUP BY t.team_id, t.team_name ORDER BY pct DESC, t.team_name

SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS total_goals, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rnk FROM goals g JOIN matches m ON g.match_id = m.match_id JOIN stadiums s ON s.stadium_id = m.stadium_id JOIN teams t ON t.team_id = g.scoring_team_id WHERE s.stadium_name = 'Atlanta Stadium' GROUP BY t.team_id, t.team_name ORDER BY rnk, t.team_name
